title: Removal of $2 Minimum for Charity Deductions
body:
Moved to Forum: Original Link
Just read up on this and wasn’t aware - the ATO has reportedly removed the $2 minimum threshold for claiming tax deductions on charity donations from 1 July 2026.
That means you may now be able to claim even very small donations, including amounts under $2, as long as the charity is eligible and you keep a receipt.
As always, keep a receipt, even for small donations.
Just tested this on a 1c donation - will report back next FY if it worked
